title: preparation-settings
description: Private immutable preparation snapshot. Credentials are references only. Expanded voices/settings, exact profiles/prompts/context/schema/adapter bindings are retained.

exercise_request.description: Original normalized simple request; null for an exclusively advanced blueprint.

generation_bindings.description: Exactly the canonical_text and mutation resolved bindings.

speech_registry_asset_id.description: Saved complete selected speech registry bytes; secret values excluded.

recipe_registry_asset_id.description: Saved complete mutation recipe registry bytes.

source_record_ids.description: Exact explicitly selected immutable source record IDs for the original generation request; empty for independent generation.

anyOf.description: SHA-256 of actual immutable bytes or JCS payload as declared.

production_registry_sha256.description: SHA-256 of actual immutable bytes or JCS payload as declared.

taxonomy_registry_asset_id.description: Saved taxonomy used by the mutation phase; absent on older clean-only preparations.

taxonomy_registry_sha256.description: Taxonomy provenance frozen with new preparation settings.

speech_profile.description: Complete initially resolved speech extension; frozen separately so the accepted configuration payload/digest remain unchanged.
